subject.title: [Feature Request] Session List: Show timestamp + last message preview

question: Should the narrow Control UI Sessions-list timestamp/preview improvement land independently, or be folded into the broader sessions overview design work?
rationale: The backend and TUI already support last-message previews, but the visible Control UI list design overlaps with open issues about session overview, derived titles, meaningful activity sorting, and peek behavior.

options.title: Land narrow list preview
options.body: Review the linked implementation PR or a focused replacement that reuses includeLastMessage and renders a compact preview in the existing Sessions table.

options.title: Fold into broader overview
options.body: Keep this issue linked to the broader sessions overview direction and close or supersede the narrow PR only after naming the canonical design issue.

options.title: Do not add previews now
options.body: Keep the Sessions table as a technical management view and close the paired PR with a maintainer-stated UX rationale.

recommendation.title: Land narrow list preview
recommendation.body: Review the linked implementation PR or a focused replacement that reuses includeLastMessage and renders a compact preview in the existing Sessions table.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest combined history across sessions.preview, Control UI sessions, and product-boundary cleanup for this UX choice.
